readiness: draft scaffolds only; no runtime or visual readiness

entries.name: Container
entries.scope: Layout policy adapter over the existing graphvex Element; anchors, pivots, padding and sizing policies must not introduce a second geometry authority.

entries.name: Canvas
entries.scope: Coordinate a root content tree and borrowed Surface/Boards; fan dirty branches and keep multiwindow presentation independent.

entries.name: Scene
entries.scope: Common retained scene interface that borrows graphvex Board/Image targets and participates in the Frame revalidation cascade.

entries.name: Scene2D
entries.scope: Retained 2D scene composition with transforms, ordering and pixel/percentage sizing; GPU execution remains in graphvex.

entries.name: Scene3D
entries.scope: Retained 3D scene composition with camera, lighting and sizing policies; mesh rendering and resource retirement remain in graphvex.

entries.name: Compositor
entries.scope: Order borrowed scene/content/overlay Boards into the single Frame presentation seam, with no second OS window or duplicate rendering loop.

entries.name: FlexPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with row/column flow, wrapping, gap, justification, alignment and hug/fill/fixed sizing policies.

entries.name: SplitPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with pane ratios, divider interaction and min/max pane constraints; child ownership follows Panel.

entries.name: TabPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with tab strip, active content, close/reorder policies and focus transfer.

entries.name: DockPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with named dock regions and splitters, borrowing Frame geometry rather than owning native windows.

entries.name: CardPanel
entries.scope: Compound Panel with header, title, description, body and footer roles; elevation and spacing are properties.

entries.name: ListPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with indexed horizontal/vertical stacking, gaps, cross-axis alignment and content sizing.

entries.name: GridPanel
entries.scope: Panel composition with rows, columns, independent gaps, cell placement and future spanning policies.

entries.name: SectionPanel
entries.scope: Compound titled header/body Panel with collapsible content and future animated height.

entries.name: LayeredPanel
entries.scope: Overlapping child Panels with explicit ordering and topmost visible hit routing.

entries.name: Accordion
entries.scope: Disclosure-group Panel composition with single/multiple expansion policies and eventual animated layout.

entries.name: TreePanel
entries.scope: Hierarchical disclosure rows for file/scene trees, selection and large-tree virtualization policies.

entries.name: TablePanel
entries.scope: Multi-column data-grid Panel with sorting, headers, resize and paginated or virtualized rows.

entries.name: MarkdownPanel
entries.scope: Markdown block/inline parsing into retained text children, with selection, links and future code/table composition.

entries.name: RichTextPanel
entries.scope: Retained rich-text document Panel with styled runs, wrapping and document-wide selection.

entries.name: MaterialPanel
entries.scope: Panel facade for borrowed graphvex material-rendered content; no material shader or GPU ownership belongs here.

entries.name: VideoPanel
entries.scope: Panel facade for decoded media frames; decoder/process supervision and image upload remain with their lower-level owners.

entries.name: SvgPanel
entries.scope: Retained SVG display Panel with path/layout interpretation and borrowed driver rendering resources.

entries.name: WebPanel
entries.scope: Capability-gated native-web-content Panel facade; platform handles are borrowed through a host bridge, not an embedded browser runtime.

entries.name: Label
entries.scope: Text widget with owned/borrowed text contracts, font requests, glyph-position hit testing, selection and clipboard intent.

entries.name: RichLabel
entries.scope: Text widget with multiple styled runs, shared selection coordinates and plain-text copy across markup.

entries.name: Kbd
entries.scope: Keycap text badge with monospaced typography, key-symbol presentation and theme spacing.

entries.name: Typography
entries.scope: UI type-role policy mapping caption/body/title/display/mono roles to borrowed font resources and theme tokens.

entries.name: TextCore
entries.scope: UI-side styled-run, text-layout and selection model; native glyph shaping/rasterization is a borrowed driver capability.

entries.name: CodeField
entries.scope: Editable code-text widget with language tokens, line-number gutter, caret/selection and future folding/multicaret policies.

entries.name: Button
entries.scope: Pressable compound Panel with label/icon/accessory slots, variants, enabled/loading state and keyboard activation intent.

entries.name: Switch
entries.scope: Boolean-choice Panel with track/thumb composition, change notifications and eventual animated state transitions.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.scope: Checked/indeterminate Panel with label hit region, value notifications and keyboard activation intent.

entries.name: RadioGroup
entries.scope: Exclusive option-list Panel with selection, disabled-option policy and eventual arrow-key traversal.

entries.name: Input
entries.scope: Single-line text-entry widget with buffer ownership, caret, selection, placeholder, clipboard and submit/change intent.

entries.name: Textarea
entries.scope: Multiline text-entry widget with document mutations, wrapping, line navigation and viewport/caret synchronization.

entries.name: Slider
entries.scope: Range-selection Panel with normalization, step snapping, orientation, track/thumb composition and keyboard nudging.

entries.name: Knob
entries.scope: Rotary range-control Panel with angle math, detents, fine adjustment and value readout.

entries.name: ScrollBar
entries.scope: Track/thumb Panel composition driven by viewport/content ratios, seek/drag intent and horizontal/vertical orientation.

entries.name: InputOTP
entries.scope: Passcode-entry Panel with digit slots, focus advance, paste splitting and bounded code storage.

entries.name: SearchField
entries.scope: Compound text input with search icon, clear action and optional shortcut badge.

entries.name: Select
entries.scope: Compound selection widget with trigger/value/content/item roles, keyboard selection and overlay popup/filter policy.

entries.name: DatePicker
entries.scope: Date-selection widget with calendar model, month navigation and future popup/month-grid composition.

entries.name: ColorPicker
entries.scope: Color-selection widget with HSV/hex editing, hue/saturation/value controls and borrowed sample intent.

entries.name: ColorSwatch
entries.scope: Selectable color-chip Panel with selection/change notifications and shared Color representation.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.scope: Modal UI wrapper over an owned/borrowed Frame contract; modal focus/close policies must use the R1 host window seam.

entries.name: OptionDialog
entries.scope: Dialog composition for action choices and explicit result/cancellation ownership.

entries.name: InputDialog
entries.scope: Dialog composition for a text prompt, bounded input, submit/cancel results and focus return.

entries.name: FileDialog
entries.scope: Dialog composition for path/filter/entry selection; file access is borrowed from vexspoke, never a new filesystem backend.

entries.name: ColorDialog
entries.scope: Dialog composition for a ColorPicker and live color-change/result notifications.

entries.name: AlertDialog
entries.scope: Dialog composition for title, body and confirmation actions, preserving modal close/cancel policy.

entries.name: OverlayRoot
entries.scope: Explicit top-level overlay tree that escapes content clips while retaining modal input isolation and one Frame presentation seam.

entries.name: Tooltip
entries.scope: Hover-hint overlay with placement/arrow intent and bounded lifetime; timers are borrowed from the owner loop.

entries.name: Popover
entries.scope: Click-anchored overlay card with light-dismiss, focus return and clipping escape policy.

entries.name: Menu
entries.scope: Hierarchical action-menu overlay with shortcuts, item selection and keyboard traversal policy.

entries.name: ContextMenu
entries.scope: Context-triggered Menu composition with point anchoring, action routing and dismissal/focus return.

entries.name: Toast
entries.scope: Nonmodal notification Panel with message/action composition and owner-driven dismissal.

entries.name: ToastStack
entries.scope: Retained queue/layout coordinator for Toast children, deadlines and removal without owning a timer thread.

entries.name: CommandPalette
entries.scope: Quick-action overlay with query/filter results, command selection and focus restoration.

entries.name: Theme
entries.scope: UI design tokens for color ramps, spacing, typography and elevation; styles reuse graphvex Color/Property rather than redefining them.

entries.name: FocusRing
entries.scope: Keyboard-focus indicator Panel tied to focus-visible policy, theme color and explicit offset.

entries.name: ProgressBar
entries.scope: Determinate/indeterminate progress Panel with normalized value, fill and owner-driven animation.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.scope: Loading-indicator Panel with owner-driven phase and rendering intent; no independent animation thread.

entries.name: Skeleton
entries.scope: Loading-placeholder Panel with shape tokens and eventual owner-driven shimmer.

entries.name: Avatar
entries.scope: Photo/initials Panel composition with optional presence badge and image fallback policy.

entries.name: Badge
entries.scope: Status-badge Panel with semantic tone, size and text/icon slots.

entries.name: Pill
entries.scope: Compact pill-shaped status/tag Panel, sharing Badge/theme conventions without duplicating layout machinery.

entries.name: Chip
entries.scope: Interactive tag Panel with dismiss action, optional avatar and selection/enabled policy.

entries.name: Breadcrumb
entries.scope: Hierarchical navigation-path Panel with separators, current item and action intent.

entries.name: Pagination
entries.scope: Page-navigation Panel with page count/current page, boundaries and previous/next actions.

entries.name: StatCard
entries.scope: KPI CardPanel composition with value, trend and borrowed Plot/sparkline content.

entries.name: Picture
entries.scope: Image-display widget with borrowed Image backing, UV crop and contain/cover/stretch policy.

entries.name: Object3D
entries.scope: UI scene-node wrapper for borrowed mesh/material resources and transform hierarchy; GPU mesh ownership remains in graphvex.

entries.name: Viewer3D
entries.scope: Scene3D viewer composition with orbit camera, lighting controls and Object3D content.

entries.name: IconImage
entries.scope: Vector/SDF icon-display widget requesting borrowed icon atlas resources and theme-driven sizing/color.

entries.name: Plot
entries.scope: Retained data-chart widget with borrowed data spans, line/bar/scatter modes, axes and data hit/tooltip intent.

entries.name: NodeEditor
entries.scope: Retained graph-canvas widget with node/pin/socket models, connection curves and edit/selection intent.

entries.name: Anim
entries.scope: Owner-driven property-animation player with easing/spring policies; no independent tick thread or duplicated scheduler.

entries.name: Cursor
entries.scope: UI cursor-selection facade; native cursor handles and application remain with the R1 host.

entries.name: History
entries.scope: UI command-history model with undo/redo and explicit borrowed command/payload lifetime contracts.

entries.name: HtmlExporter
entries.scope: UI-tree-to-HTML serialization policy; source tree is borrowed and output ownership/escaping must be defined before implementation.

entries.name: HudBar
entries.scope: HUD value-bar Panel with primary fill, delayed ghost drain and damage-feedback intent.

entries.name: CooldownButton
entries.scope: Button composition with owner-driven cooldown phase, radial progress and hotkey/ready indicators.

entries.name: DamageNumbers
entries.scope: Pooled floating-text Panel coordinator with bounded combat-text lifetime and owner-driven motion.

entries.name: InventoryGrid
entries.scope: GridPanel composition for item slots, stack counts, tier styles, locks and drag/drop intent.

entries.name: DialogBox
entries.scope: NPC-dialogue Panel composition with portrait, text reveal and action choices.

entries.name: Minimap
entries.scope: Scene/Panel composition for map/radar content, player direction, pings and fog-mask intent.

entries.name: GamepadNav
entries.scope: Spatial focus-navigation policy for D-pad directions, bumper tabs and device glyph requests.

entries.name: SpatialCanvas
entries.scope: Retained pan/zoom content-canvas policy with guides, minimap and borrowed driver transforms; no separate render loop.

entries.name: TransformBox
entries.scope: Interactive bounding-handle Panel with translation/scale/rotation intent, aspect locking and geometry constraints.

entries.name: PropertyInspector
entries.scope: Retained property-editing Panel composition with explicit bindings for geometry, paint and text; edits use shared properties operations.

entries.name: Window bridge
entries.scope: UI root attachment/resize/input glue over hotcwap Window; never a second Window class or native backend.

entries.name: Font bake bridge
entries.scope: UI font request/cache binding over borrowed graphvex font resources; no new font baker.

entries.name: Text ObjC bridge
entries.scope: Platform-capability routing for text shaping/rasterization supplied by the driver/host, with no native implementation in this draft.

entries.name: Panel Cocoa bridge
entries.scope: UI Panel/Board attachment and lifecycle glue over the existing single Frame presentation seam.

entries.name: Clipboard bridge
entries.scope: Translate UI selection/copy/paste intent into existing vexspoke io/clipboard.h; do not redeclare or duplicate Clipboard_* native functions.

entries.name: Color helpers
entries.scope: UI color-format conversion policy using the existing graphvex Color scalar; do not introduce an incompatible second Color typedef.

entries.name: Emoji text support
entries.scope: Text fallback/emoji presentation policy for Label and rich-text content; shaping and native font capabilities remain borrowed.

entries.name: Event bridge
entries.scope: Translate host event payloads into existing c23/event_invoke dispatch, preserving window-scoped coordinates and ownership.

entries.name: Key events
entries.scope: Focused-target keyboard delivery policy over shared event carriers; no Key struct duplication or blanket widget opt-ins.

entries.name: Document events
entries.scope: Text mutation notification policy for insertion/removal/replacement over existing document event carriers.

entries.name: Focus events
entries.scope: Focus acquisition/release, traversal, focus-visible and modal trapping policy over the retained tree.

entries.name: Gesture events
entries.scope: Gesture-recognition policy over borrowed scroll/pinch/pan payloads and owner-driven timing.

entries.name: Action events
entries.scope: Abstract UI command dispatch and activation policy using borrowed handler/context lifetimes.

entries.name: Value events
entries.scope: Value-change notification policy for controls, with explicit delivery/reentrancy contracts to be defined.

entries.name: Tree events
entries.scope: Hierarchy mutation notification policy for attach/detach/dirty changes without duplicating the live tree operations.

entries.name: Darling type registry
entries.scope: Future single Darling class registry; allocate no identities for unimplemented drafts and never duplicate lower-level registry IDs.

entries.name: set_anchor
entries.scope: Parent anchor property routing over existing Element/Panel placement; migrate existing setters here rather than define parallel behavior.

entries.name: set_pivot
entries.scope: Self-pivot property routing over existing Element/Panel placement; migrate existing setters here rather than define parallel behavior.

entries.name: set_padding
entries.scope: Future inner-spacing operation; layout contribution and interaction with child sizing must be specified before implementation.

entries.name: set_margin
entries.scope: Future additive external-spacing operation; semantics must remain separate from anchor/location and be defined before implementation.

entries.name: set_border
entries.scope: Border width/color property routing; eventually migrate current widget setters and preserve CPU/GPU paint contracts.

entries.name: set_shadow
entries.scope: Shadow offset/blur/color property routing; eventually migrate existing setters and retain layout-versus-paint bounds.

entries.name: set_blur
entries.scope: Own-edge/backdrop effect property routing with explicitly separate contracts and capability gates.

entries.name: set_visible
entries.scope: Visibility property routing and eventual revalidation/input consequences; migrate existing setters rather than add competing implementations.

entries.name: set_text
entries.scope: Future text-content ownership/mutation operation for text widgets; no setters declared until their types/lifetimes exist.

entries.name: set_font
entries.scope: Future typography/font request operation that borrows lower-level font resources.

entries.name: set_value
entries.scope: Future typed control-value operation with range/clamp/notification contracts.

entries.name: set_enabled
entries.scope: Future control enabled-state operation with input and appearance policy.

entries.name: set_focus
entries.scope: Future focus-state operation over the event/focus coordinator and retained tree.

entries.name: set_scroll_offset
entries.scope: Future shared scroll-offset operation preserving ScrollPanel clamp/revalidation semantics.

entries.name: set_theme
entries.scope: Future theme-token binding operation for widgets and compound parts.

entries.name: set_alignment
entries.scope: Future content/cross-axis alignment operation; do not conflate it with anchor/pivot.

entries.name: set_gap
entries.scope: Future flow/grid child-gap operation with layout revalidation policy.

entries.name: set_sizing_mode
entries.scope: Future fixed/hug/fill layout policy operation with explicit measurement semantics.

entries.name: set_background_color
entries.scope: Background paint routing; eventually migrate current setters while preserving explicit window-transparency independence.

existing.name: Frame
existing.scope: Window/lifecycle/accessors; shared operations route through properties/.

existing.name: Panel
existing.scope: Live wrapper over graphvex Element with existing ownership and paint API.

existing.name: ScrollPanel
existing.scope: Live viewport over content, with clamped offsets and clipping.

existing.name: Pointer events
existing.scope: Existing real-input bridge; no replacement dispatcher scaffold.

existing.name: Event dispatch
existing.scope: Existing handler registration/bubbling and typed event carriers.

existing.name: c23/add
existing.scope: Current canonical Frame/Panel attachment operations; no duplicate c23/add implementation.

existing.name: remove/revalidate/size/location/radius
existing.scope: Existing shared operation files, left untouched.

existing.name: Font bake / raster / Surface
existing.scope: Driver-owned capabilities, not recreated as R4 implementations.

existing.name: IO mmap / IO bake / native Clipboard
existing.scope: Leaf I/O/native clipboard capabilities, not duplicated.

existing.name: Native Window
existing.scope: Host-owned native window; Frame/bridge only borrow it.

existing.name: Color representation
existing.scope: Reuse Color; color/color is a helper-policy placeholder, not another class.
